relationships.subject: PT glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: PTGlu neurons project to both ACC pyramidal neurons and interneurons

relationships.subject: PT glutamatergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic or chemogenetic activation of the PTGlu-ACC circuit aggravates mechanical and thermal hyperalgesia.

key_findings: PT-glutamatergic to ACC circuit is aberrantly activated in OIH; activating it worsens hyperalgesia and inhibiting it is analgesic.
OIH reduces feedforward inhibition and causes I/E imbalance in ACC pyramidal neurons.
